This Q60 is being offered differently from Infiniti of Boerne's normally reconditioned pre-owned inventory.

An independent inspection can help a buyer better understand the vehicle's current condition and determine whether any maintenance or repairs should be anticipated. TRANSPARENCY BEFORE THE SALE

And if you're someone who likes making a car your own, you've picked the right platform. The FR-S/BRZ/86 aftermarket is massive, with countless options for suspension, wheels, exhaust, appearance upgrades, and performance modifications. Keep it simple or build it into something completely unique.

It's also a car that fits right into the Florida lifestyle. Cruise around Ormond Beach, head into Daytona Beach, or take the long way down A1A toward New Smyrna Beach this is one of those cars where getting there can be just as enjoyable as the destination.

description: POWERFUL, LUXURIOUS, ALL ELECTRIC, BARELY BROKEN IN, ONE-OWNER, NONSMOKER, THE PINNACLE OF ELECTRIC TRUCKS! The 2026 GMC Sierra EV Denali Max Range is one of the most advanced and luxurious pickups ever built, combining staggering electric performance with Denali-level refinement. Finished in Deep Ocean Metallic, this Crew Cab pairs GMC's largest battery pack with up to 760 horsepower, four-wheel steering with CrabWalk, an air suspension, and the versatile MultiPro Midgate. With just under 12,000 miles on the odometer, this Sierra EV has barely been broken in, and it comes from a single owner. It still carries substantial remaining factory warranty coverage, including GM's 8-year/100,000-mile protection for the battery and electric propulsion components. Why Shoppers Buy This Model The Sierra EV gives truck buyers something truly unique: the capability of a full-size pickup combined with sports-car acceleration, near-silent operation, and the ability to power tools, campsites, or even a home. Its Max Range battery delivers the longest range in the Sierra EV lineup, making road trips and long workdays far easier to plan. Shoppers are also drawn to the Denali's exceptional luxury and clever engineering, from the lockable eTrunk under the hood to the MultiPro Midgate that extends the bed into the cabin for long items. For drivers who want the ultimate electric truck without compromise, few vehicles can match it. Automotive Press and Industry Recognition Reviewers have praised the Sierra EV Denali for its astonishing acceleration, serene and quiet ride, upscale interior, and genuinely clever features like the MultiPro Midgate, eTrunk, and four-wheel steering with CrabWalk. Critics also highlight its impressive range and fast charging capability, while noting that its considerable weight and size are worth keeping in mind in tight urban spaces. Warranty The odometer currently shows 11,984 miles, and this Sierra EV is STILL COVERED by substantial remaining factory warranty protection. Remaining Transferable Factory Coverage: Bumper-to-Bumper Limited Warranty -- 3 years or 36,000 miles from the original registration date, whichever comes first. Coverage runs through July 2028 or 36,000 miles. EV Propulsion and Battery Limited Warranty -- 8 years or 100,000 miles, whichever comes first, covering the high-voltage battery and electric propulsion components. Coverage runs through July 2033 or 100,000 miles. Rust-Through Corrosion Coverage -- 6 years or 100,000 miles, whichever comes first. Coverage runs through July 2031 or 100,000 miles. Extended service plans may also be available for buyers who want additional peace of mind beyond the factory coverage. To the best of our abilities, we believe the following warranties are still intact and not negated by GM's anti-flip rule, but you're welcome to check with an authorized GMC dealership. Standard Features The Denali represents the Sierra EV at its most luxurious, with heated and ventilated front seats, premium interior materials, a panoramic fixed glass roof, and a 16.8-inch touchscreen with Google built-in. An 11-inch digital driver information center and a head-up display keep key information in view, while a Bose premium audio system fills the cabin with rich sound. The Denali also brings four-wheel steering with CrabWalk, Air Ride Adaptive Suspension, the MultiPro Midgate and MultiPro Tailgate, a lockable eTrunk under the hood, and Super Cruise driver-assistance technology. Super Cruise capability. Purchaser should verify current subscription/activation status with GMC before relying on this feature. Installed Options Deep Ocean Metallic paint A rich, deep blue finish that gives this Sierra EV a sophisticated, commanding presence. Truck Capability The Sierra EV's bed is roughly 5 feet 11 inches long, and the MultiPro Midgate lets you fold the rear seats and open a pass-through into the cabin, extending cargo length to carry lumber, kayaks, or other long items with the tailgate closed. The MultiPro Tailgate adds a step and work surface, while the lockable, weatherproof eTrunk under the hood provides secure storage for tools and gear. Towing and payload figures here are estimates: comparably equipped Sierra EV Denali Max Range models are rated to tow approximately 9,500 pounds with a payload of roughly 1,300 pounds, while other Sierra EV configurations are rated up to 12,500 pounds. The truck's onboard power system can also supply electricity to power tools, a campsite, or essential home appliances when properly equipped. Charging, Range & Electrified Powertrain The Max Range battery pack delivers a GM-estimated range of up to 478 miles, the longest in the Sierra EV lineup and enough to handle long road trips and demanding workdays with fewer charging stops. The dual-motor e4WD powertrain produces up to 760 horsepower and 785 lb-ft of torque in Max Power mode, delivering breathtaking, silent acceleration with no tailpipe emissions. Level 1 (120-volt household outlet): useful for occasional top-ups, but best suited to limited use given the size of the battery. Level 2 (240-volt): the most convenient everyday solution, ideal for recharging overnight, with charging speed depending on the charger's output. DC Fast Charging (up to 350 kW): thanks to its 800-volt architecture, it can add roughly 100 miles of range in about 10 minutes at a compatible fast charger, ideal for road trips. Mechanical Features With electric motors driving both axles, the e4WD system delivers exceptional traction and instant torque, launching this full-size truck from 0 to 60 mph in about 4.5 seconds in Max Power mode. Four-wheel steering sharply reduces the turning radius for easier parking and maneuvering, while CrabWalk lets the truck move diagonally to navigate tight spaces. The Air Ride Adaptive Suspension continuously adjusts to road conditions and load, delivering a smooth, controlled ride and allowing the truck to raise or lower as needed. One-pedal driving and regenerative braking help recapture energy, extend range, and make stop-and-go traffic far less tiring. Exterior Features Deep Ocean Metallic gives this Sierra EV a rich, sophisticated finish that highlights its bold, sculpted design and signature Denali styling. Illuminated GMC lighting elements and LED headlamps give it a commanding presence day or night. The panoramic fixed glass roof adds a sense of openness overhead, while the eTrunk, MultiPro Midgate, and MultiPro Tailgate make this truck as practical as it is beautiful. Interior Features Inside, the Denali offers a spacious, beautifully finished cabin with premium materials, heated and ventilated front seats, and a panoramic fixed glass roof that floods the interior with natural light. With no engine noise, the cabin is exceptionally quiet at any speed. The rear seat offers generous legroom for adults, and the 60/40 split-folding rear seats work with the MultiPro Midgate to extend the bed into the cabin when you need to carry longer items. Infotainment & Technology The 16.8-inch touchscreen with Google built-in brings Google Maps with EV-focused route planning, Google Assistant voice control, and apps from Google Play right into the dashboard, along with Bluetooth phone connectivity. The 11-inch digital driver information center, head-up display, and Bose premium audio system complete a truly modern cabin. GMC connected services are also included. Subscription may be required to maintain service. Safety Features This Sierra EV is equipped with an extensive suite of safety and driver-assistance technology, including Super Cruise, Automatic Emergency Braking, Lane Keep Assist, blind zone monitoring, and multiple available camera views that make maneuvering and hitching a trailer easier. A comprehensive airbag system rounds out an exceptional safety package. ... and there's SO MUCH more! If available, vehicle files can be found above this description on our website, including the original brochure and window sticker! The Bottom Line This Sierra EV Denali Max Range combines staggering electric performance, genuine truck capability, and true luxury, from its 760-horsepower powertrain and long-range battery to four-wheel steering, air suspension, and the MultiPro Midgate. With just under 12,000 miles, a single owner, and substantial factory warranty coverage remaining, it is an extraordinary opportunity to own one of the most advanced trucks on the road. A trunk under the hood, a midgate in the middle, and 760 silent horsepower underneath -- this Sierra EV is the Swiss Army knife of luxury trucks. We will happily evaluate your TRADE-IN and offer EXCELLENT FINANCE OPTIONS as well, so please give us a call at 732-919-0707 (Wall Township) or 856-881-2869 (Sewell) TODAY!

This 2025 Ram 1500 Tungsten Crew Cab combines factory luxury appointments with a set of well-chosen exterior modifications, including a Rough Country 6" lift with a four-wheel alignment, 20" Fuel Sigma FC869 black wheels, 35x12.50R20 Nitto Ridge Grappler tires, and professionally installed window tint backed by a lifetime warranty. The Diamond Black Crystal Pearl Coat paint gives the body a dark, uniform finish, while the lifted stance and larger wheel-and-tire package add visual presence without changing the straightforward nature of the truck's equipment list. The tinted glass ties the exterior together while also being listed as a separate installed feature, and it is integrated cleanly rather than treated as an afterthought.

This Crew Cab is specified with the Tungsten trim's upscale cabin equipment, including premium leather bucket seats and leather seating surfaces throughout the interior. The panoramic sunroof brings natural light into the cabin, and the head up display places key information where it is easy to read without taking focus away from the road. The seating, trim materials, and glass roof are paired with a restrained design approach that matches the rest of the vehicle, and the interior hardware is presented as part of the truck's original equipment rather than an added theme or special edition. A Wi-Fi hotspot is also included, giving the truck connected capability that fits with its modern feature set.

Driver-assistance and convenience equipment is listed clearly on this Ram, starting with adaptive cruise control and lane keep assist. Those systems are joined by a trailer brake controller, which is part of the truck's tow-focused equipment, and the trailer tow group, which adds the supporting hardware associated with that role. The dual function tailgate is also included, giving the rear access panel added versatility without altering the basic utility of the cargo area. With the 3.92 axle ratio noted in the build, the truck's drivetrain specification is documented alongside the other equipment rather than left implied, and the overall feature list reflects a truck that was ordered with both comfort and capability in mind.

This 2025 Ram 1500 Tungsten Crew Cab presents a combination of premium materials, driver aids, and towing equipment in a format that is easy to verify from the option list. The Quick Order Package 22V is part of the build, and the remaining equipment builds around that foundation with a direct, practical focus. The exterior changes are visible and specific, while the interior and technology items remain consistent with the Tungsten nameplate and the rest of the truck's listed content. Every feature mentioned here is accounted for in the equipment list, from the lifted suspension and wheel package to the cabin appointments, connectivity, and towing-related items, giving a clear picture of what is included without adding anything beyond the stated details.----We've built an unmatched reputation over the last two decades for customizing and selling thousands of the highest quality used vehicles in the country. These vehicles then go through an 82 point inspection process to guarantee quality and safety. Our lift kits are installed by our own factory-trained technicians, who have thousands of hours of experience. The installation is then inspected by a second dedicated quality control technician, before being sent to our state of the art Hunter Engineering laser alignment rack. Our aftermarket research and development team always matches the best fitting lift kit, shocks, and wheel & tire combinations to each individual vehicle for optimal off-road performance, while maintaining an incredibly smooth ride on the street. The 5.5 ft. short bed keeps the body proportions compact enough for everyday use, and the illuminated door entry keypad adds another factory detail that fits the truck's premium specification. The overall presentation is clean and direct, with the modifications and equipment listed plainly rather than layered with ornament.

Inside, the cabin is trimmed with leather seats and ordered around the features included in Equipment Group 702A. A panoramic sunroof brings in additional light across both rows, while the head up display places key driving information in the driver's line of sight. Adaptive Cruise Control and Lane Keep Assist are both included, and the truck also has a Wi-Fi hotspot for connected use on the road. The first aid kit is part of the equipment list as well, and the interior combines comfort-oriented materials with the controls and display content expected in a high-series F-150. The result is a space that is equipped for longer drives without adding unnecessary complication.

The truck is also specified with the FX4 Off-Road Package, which aligns with the lifted suspension and the larger tire package already fitted. The 3.55 electronic locking axle ratio is listed with the Tow/Haul Upgrade, and the truck includes the wheel lock kit with exposed hardware. The 50 state emissions system is present, so the vehicle is listed for nationwide compliance rather than a region-specific configuration. These items sit alongside the rest of the factory equipment in a way that keeps the build focused on function, with the mechanical and chassis-related details given equal weight to the cabin features. The combination of hardware and options gives the truck a clear, documented specification without relying on added claims.

From the outside, the Platinum trim's cleaner bodywork is matched to the Star White Metallic Tri-Coat finish and the darker wheel treatment beneath it. The tinted glass carries through the truck's sharper visual line while also remaining a practical, documented addition rather than a decorative one. With the SuperCrew cab, the short bed, and the higher ride height from the suspension work, the truck keeps the long-cab presence that defines this body style while maintaining a profile that remains easy to recognize from any angle. Our lift kits are installed by our own factory-trained technicians, who have thousands of hours of experience. The installation is then inspected by a second dedicated quality control technician, before being sent to our state of the art Hunter Engineering laser alignment rack. Our aftermarket research and development team always matches the best fitting lift kit, shocks, and wheel & tire combinations to each individual vehicle for optimal off-road performance, while maintaining an incredibly smooth ride on the street. We never cut any corners on our builds, which is why we only use top quality name brand products when building your Truck, SUV or Jeep. And when you're pulling a heavy fifth-wheel, large camper, horse trailer, equipment trailer or toys across the country, you don't have to give up comfort to get capability. The Platinum cabin surrounds you with Black leather, heated and ventilated front seats, heated steering wheel, navigation, B&O premium audio, adaptive cruise control, SYNC 3, and a power twin-panel moonroof.

2022 Ford F450 Super Duty Crew Cab Safety and Security Features

This truck offers a comprehensive safety package, including a trailer rearview camera system to assist with towing. Rear parking sensors help with precise parking, while four-wheel ABS provides stability in various conditions. An interior motion sensor anti-theft system and anti-tow sensors work together to prevent unauthorized access and theft. Emergency braking preparation enhances safety during sudden stops, and power door locks with auto-locking and anti-lockout features ensure security. The programmable safety key allows owners to set personalized security parameters, adding an extra layer of protection.

2022 Ford F450 Super Duty Crew Cab Entertainment and Technology Features

With 1000 watts of premium audio power, nine speakers, and a subwoofer, it delivers immersive sound quality. FordPass Connect enables smart device app compatibility, offering remote engine start and cabin preconditioning. Hands-free voice-operated phone calls and HD radio provide seamless entertainment options. The system’s user-friendly interface ensures quick access to features, making every drive enjoyable and connected.

2022 Ford F450 Super Duty Crew Cab Performance Features

This heavy-duty truck features an electronic hi-lo 4WD selector, allowing drivers to switch between high and low ranges for optimal traction. The rear limited slip differential enhances stability and control when hauling or towing heavy loads. Its part-time 4WD system is designed for versatile performance on various terrains, providing confidence whether on rough jobsites or paved roads. This combination of features ensures the F450 can handle demanding tasks with ease and reliability.

Factory equipment also includes 18-inch polished forged aluminum wheels, all-terrain tires, LED cargo-bed lighting, integrated bed steps, Chevytec spray-on bedliner, power-folding/extending trailering mirrors, and 120-volt cab and bed outlets.
